newsitem.title: GERMANY: Lufthansa says sees no chance for strike.
newsitem.headline: Lufthansa says sees no chance for strike.

text.p: Lufthansa AG said on Wednesday it saw no current danger of a strike threat after the union representing pilots, flight attendants and ground workers said only pilots had given approval for a possible strike action.
The German airline also said it has called on the DAG union to negotiate to end the wage dispute following the announcement of the ballots results after a six-week voting period.
"There is currently no threat of a strike with these results," the airline said in a statement.

The DAG said earlier on Tuesday that pilots gave 87 percent approval for strike action if talks with Lufthansa failed to reach an appropriate deal but that flight attendants and ground workers had failed to reach the minimum 70 percent quorum.
